chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Those who
trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion,which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

As the
mountains surround Jerusalem,so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

For the
scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous,so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

Do good,
Yahweh, to those who are good,to those who are upright in their hearts.

But as
for those who turn away to their crooked ways,Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity.Peace be on Israel.
